title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description: Guy Fieri road trips across America to check out classic greasy spoons; with a new generation of owners and delicious homemade food, these are the kind of places that make America special.

title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy
description: Danielle Sepsy transforms everyday fruits and vegetables into comforting, bakery-style treats; first, she creates her Best Carrot Cake, layering moist cake with tangy cream cheese frosting; then, ripe bananas become soft, sweet Sugar Cookie Banana Bread.

title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy
description: Danielle Sepsy teams up with her mom to make Pepperoni Stromboli with a flavorful filling and golden crust; Danielle welcomes her grandma to the kitchen to make a Mile High Classic Top-Heavy Deli Crumb Cake with a thick layer of buttery crumbs.

title: The Kitchen
description: The Kitchen goes big on Thanksgiving flavors with mashup favorites! Katie Lee Biegel makes Spinach Artichoke Dip Stuffed Mushrooms, Jeff Mauro preps Jalapeños and Cranberry Stuffed Turkey Breast and Sunny Anderson bakes Adult Pecan Pie Brownie Bars.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description: Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson invite four cookie-making couples to make two gift tags -- one for each of them; the pairs then construct a fortress fit to withstand a snowball fight with a ready pile of snowballs in hopes of winning $10,000.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description: Five bakers take on a stringy trend and build Christmas cookie carousels.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description: Five cookie makers must come up with gingerbread men costumes and are challenged to construct candy filled versions of Downtown North Pole.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description: Five cookie makers reveal who's on Santa's list by creating cookies showing someone doing a good deed and another being naughty; competitors create a display of cookie angel figurines filled with good spirits.

title: The Kitchen
description: The kitchen puts side dishes on center stage and Jeff Mauro shares his essential tips for stuffing; recipes include smoked Gouda skillet Mac and Cheese, herbed potato salad and twice baked miso sweet potatoes; Jeff has ways to use leftovers.

title: The Kitchen
description: The kitchen is serving up drink and app pairings from around the world, from fresh raspberry and coconut water sangria with albondigas, to charcuterie chips and a French gimlet; the hosts chat about the season of "Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking!".

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description: Tina Fey joins Ina Garten for a fun-filled day of deep conversation and cooking; Ina welcomes Tina with Breakfast Panna Cotta; they team up to make Tina's signature Greek Lemon Potatoes served with Ina's Chicken Thighs with Creamy Mustard Sauce.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description: Molly Yeh plans on hosting a costume bonfire; she makes Summer Sausage en Croute, Pot of Beans with Runny Eggs, Kinako White Hot Chocolates and Red Velvet S'mores with Black Sesame. Marshmallows to toast around the fire.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: Chef Robert Irvine rolls into Colorado Springs, Colo., where the chef and owner of Momma Pearl's Cajun Kitchen is on the verge of losing his wife and his business if he can't shed his arrogant alter ego.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: In Keenesburg, Colo., chef Robert Irvine finds the owner of Denos I-76 abandoned by her employees and working herself into the ground; Robert must help her find staff and inspiration to turn this truck stop diner into a must-see destination.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: Chef Robert Irvine travels to Loveland, Colo., to revive a family-run Mexican restaurant where the owners haven't made a dime since they opened six years ago; Robert has two days to save this restaurant from closing its doors forever.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: At Rest Haven in Clarksdale, Miss., owner Paula's unwillingness to change is destroying her father's Lebanese restaurant and her son's chance of inheriting it; Robert Irvine must teach Paula to trust her son and her staff to save the family's legacy.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: Robert Irvine meets Ray, an ex-con who turned his life around but can't find success with his restaurant; with bad decor and no systems, Robert must help Ray transform his business and build his brand.

title: Candified: Home for the Holidays
description: With one room down, Jackie and her team race to the kitchen and dining room to bring the holiday house to life; with five weeks left, a national gummy shortage puts the project in danger of not finishing on time.

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description: Guy Fieri lights up the arena with three more holly jolly matchups! In the final battle of the night, TOC runner-up Kevin Lee and acclaimed chef Shota Nakajima go against Food Network Star winner Aarti Sequeira and pastry master Stephanie Boswell.
